visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Medium full shot of a person lying in a messy bed with white floral sheets and a large pink pillow. A small brown and black dog sits by their head. The lighting is bright and indoor. (2) The person sits up quickly, wearing floral patterned pajamas. Their short black hair is extremely frizzy and unkempt. They have a shocked facial expression, hands reaching up to their head. (3) A screen transition occurs with animated white star graphics. The person is now sitting calmly with perfectly neat, straight hair. They hold a white rectangular device in their right hand. (4) Series of close-up shots show the person's hands holding the white device and brushing through different sections of their hair, including the bangs and sides. The device has a black brush head and pinkish-white body. (5) A split-screen before-and-after graphic shows the back and side views of the hair, contrasting frizzy textures with smooth ones. Yellow and pink text overlays appear on the screen. (6) The person holds two versions of the brush, one white and one pink, while speaking to the camera. They gesture with their hands to emphasize the product's lightness. (7) Close-up shot of a white carrying case on a white bed, followed by a hand placing the case into a beige and brown designer tote bag. (8) Final medium shot of the person smiling and holding both brushes against the bedroom backdrop. (9) A black screen appears with brand text in white.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, excited female exclamation and the sound of rustling bedding. A bright, upbeat acoustic-pop BGM with a steady electronic beat (approx. 120 BPM) starts immediately. (2) Narration starts in a friendly, conversational Mandarin tone. The voice is clear and at a moderate conversational speed. The BGM remains steady in the background. (3) A distinct 'sparkle' SFX marks a transition point. The speaker's pitch rises with enthusiasm as they describe the hair straightening results. (4) Technical product descriptions follow, delivered with professional clarity. The BGM tempo stays constant, providing high energy. (5) As the narration closes, the BGM begins a gentle fade-out. The track ends in studio-clean silence after the final brand name is mentioned.
